queries.name: tokenizer_title
queries.query: ti:tokenizer OR ti:tokenizers OR ti:tokenization OR ti:tokenisation

queries.name: subword
queries.query: abs:"subword segmentation" OR abs:"subword tokenization" OR abs:"subword units" OR abs:"subword vocabulary"

queries.name: bpe_unigram_wordpiece
queries.query: abs:"byte pair encoding" OR abs:"byte-pair encoding" OR abs:sentencepiece OR abs:wordpiece OR abs:"unigram language model"

queries.name: tokenizer_free
queries.query: abs:"tokenizer-free" OR abs:"tokenization-free" OR abs:"byte-level language model" OR abs:"character-level language model"

queries.name: vocabulary_size
queries.query: abs:"vocabulary size" AND (abs:tokenizer OR abs:tokenization)

queries.name: fertility_fairness
queries.query: (abs:fertility OR abs:fairness OR abs:parity) AND (abs:tokenizer OR abs:tokenization)

queries.name: tokenization_effects
queries.query: (abs:arithmetic OR abs:numbers OR abs:code OR abs:reasoning) AND ti:tokenization

relevance.topic_description: Research where tokenization is a primary contribution or a main experimental variable: subword tokenization algorithms such as BPE, WordPiece, Unigram and SentencePiece; byte-level, character-level and tokenizer-free language models; vocabulary size; multilingual tokenizer fairness and fertility; and the effects of tokenization on arithmetic, code and reasoning.
